# FinanzBuddy 0.3.1

Hotfix release on branch `bugfix-0.3.1`: dashboard accuracy for **All accounts**, settings and transaction UX polish, table styling fixes, and immediate stock position updates after sells.

## Dashboard — All accounts

- **Opening / current / closing balance** now match the sum of per-account dashboard values (prognosis chain), not raw ledger totals.
- Per-account breakdown tables for **balance**, **opening balance (forecast)**, and **closing balance (forecast)** when viewing All accounts (click the corresponding tiles).
- **Savings pots:** parent pots with children are no longer double-counted in totals and breakdown rows.
- **Expenses tile** includes forecast flows and stock purchases (aligned with the expense event filter subtotal).
- **Difference (income − expenses)** shows `income − expenses`; the inline delta on the closing balance tile shows `closing − opening` (includes depot price changes).
- **Depot opening balance** uses holdings cost basis on the last day of the previous period.
- Stock purchase events use the salary-period date range; depot ledger lots are excluded from All-accounts aggregation where appropriate.
- **Savings-pot-only view:** compact 2-row tile layout (opening / closing / difference when balance is hidden).

## Dashboard — layout (earlier 0.3.1 commits)

- Row 1: Balance | Buys | Income  
- Row 2: Fixed costs | Variable costs | Expenses  
- Row 3: Opening balance | Closing balance | Difference  
- Inline deltas with tooltips for income, expenses, buys, and liquid funds.

## Navigation & shell

- Top sub-navigation renders again in its own row below the main bar (not squeezed into the flex row).

## Tables

- Amount column bands span from the top of the first data row to the bottom of the last row (column edges, not text width).
- **Fixed costs** list uses the same entry wrapper styling as other amount tables (card background, spacing below header/pagination).
- Settings tiles: equal width in grid rows; amount band radius tweaks.

## Transactions

- Improved type filters (checkboxes, forecast handling).
- Stock buy/sell rows styled consistently with buy-list groups.

## Settings & accounts

- Account maintenance (Kontopflege): refined account form modal and accounts panel.
- Depot linked ledger and account kind handling improvements.

## Stocks & depot

- **Share count updates immediately** after a sell (or lot edit/delete/buy) without clicking “Refresh quotes”.
- Portfolio list cache is patched on mutations; detail view reloads from the database first (`skipQuotes`), then refreshes quotes in the background.
- Stock price chart and news carousel adjustments.

## Onboarding

- Overlay flow and copy updates.

## Backend

- New `dashboard_accounts` module: per-account balance totals for All accounts.
- Extended `MonthView` API: `expenseCents`, account balance breakdown row arrays.
- Prognostic / period scope helpers for savings-pot hierarchy.

## Branding

- Regenerated Tauri / platform app icons.
